scope: Sensor adapter implementation and visibility fixtures only. No controller changes, no physics integration, no fulltrace depth campaign by adapter owner.
geometry_choice: Exact saved6decimalcollisionDEM source faces and original feature meshes with exactSDFtransforms; visible robotCAD/fork/shaft/belts as occluders; invisible contactproxies omitted.
precision_note: MuJoCo stores compiled mesh vertices asfloat32. Sourceface query comparison gave rangeerror<=4.51e-8m and normalvectorerror<=1.08e-6 in the three fixedMarsfixture rays; edgeambiguity must still be evaluated.
performance_note: One pose repeated20times:14.5ms per four-camera64x48batch; offline throughput only, not realtime guarantee or wholetrace runtime.
mapper_boundary: DepthFrame exposes only depth,mask,intrinsics,extrinsics,capturepose/capture+delivery times. Self-first-hits invalid with no searchthrough. Geometry/IDs/normals available only privately/evaluator.
limitations: Ideal range, calibration, capture-time pose and model-based selfmask; no actual camera/SLAM or hardware evidence.
Robot optical geometry is declared visibleCAD, not identical to Gazebo collision proxy geometry.
Scene coverage requires caller crop expanded by camera range+mount margin; camera poses/specs are frozen by protocol.
Existing tests and independent13campaignhelper cases are separate; this18count covers owned depth tests only.
